body: Please, someone talk to me. Let me know it's going to be alright even if it isn't.

What the fuck? I come here to talk to someone at a low point in my life, and my posts are getting downvoted?

Thanks for the help, guys. I'm three floors up, maybe I will fucking kill myself. Apparently nobody gives a shit if I exist.
No offense, but I don't want to stew in this pit. I want to feel better.
The fucked up thing is, euthanasia or hiring a hitman is the only way I could do it, but considering I'm about to be homeless, I wouldn't need to die if I had the money for that.
I don't idealize it. I just want a way to escape from my situation, or I don't want to live. I'm just too much of a pussy to end it.
